trace.native_order: per logical pixel G16BE R16BE B16BE (Lever-2 ws2816_pack_pixel); the rgb16hex dump is R16 G16 B16, a lossless reorder
trace.boundary: ws2816_wire and ws2816_wire_secondary after show_secondary_leds() and the primary Lever-2 pack, before FastLED.show() (submission suppressed by K1_EMU_SKIP_EMIT)

profile.limiter: Main RPL Lever-2 packs each edge with budget_proxy = n*3*65535 (identity) and init_leds() returns before FastLED.setMaxPowerInVoltsAndMilliamps(), so the compiled 2500 mA default installs no limit. The production max_current_ma command installs FastLED's shared power limit; the fixture records the scale FastLED would apply at submission per captured frame (limit_scale, power_mw).

time.coordinate: replay sample index; a command at hop h applies at sample h*96, before hop h is processed
time.elapsed_formula: app_us = epoch_us + processed_samples * 1000000 / 12800 (64-bit); one full hop = 7500 us

client.name: pio device monitor
client.note: The existing local control client documented for typed ':' command lines (AGENTS.md 'pio device monitor' serial monitor with command input). No dedicated scripted typed-command client exists in the repository. The runner adds --project-dir <run-owned empty dir> and --port <run-owned pty> (product envs declare monitor_port as a physical device, so no project environment is ever loaded) and types each declared line at its keyboard after the fixture's EMU_CLIENT_GATE.

smoke-a.purpose: Corrected normal-profile smoke replay: compiled defaults, normal startup animation and fade, declared epoch 1.0 s (the product's own fade gate), 128 real hops, no tail.

smoke-b.purpose: Fresh repeat of smoke-a in a new process.

time-zero-tail.purpose: Zero epoch: first real hop is processed sample 96 at 7500 us. Declared 8-hop zero tail advances processed time while admitted stays 12288.

stall-probe.purpose: Progress deadline: a 1 ms real-time show deadline must end the run as a reported stall with positions and the partial capture.

ctl-a.purpose: A-only brightness: production photons=0.25 at hop 40.

ctl-b.purpose: B-only brightness: production secondary_photons=0.15 at hop 40.

reject.purpose: Known rejected input: photons=not-a-number at hop 30 must be rejected by the production parser and leave both outputs unchanged.

limit-base.purpose: Binding limiter: the production max_current_ma=300 command installs FastLED's shared power limit (5 V x 300 mA).

limit-a.purpose: Binding limiter plus A-only photons=0.25 at hop 40.

comp-save.purpose: Apply the studio_ab composition through the production parser at hop 0, confirm it applied, then save_show at hop 64 into run-owned emulator flash.

comp-ref.purpose: Equivalent reference: the same composition applied before the first hop, same PCM, startup and epoch, no save.

comp-recover.purpose: Fresh process from comp-save's LittleFS: recovery mode issues no command, reapplication or save.

client-a.purpose: ctl-a delivered by the existing client through the product's USBSerial and production receive loop: photons=0.25 applied before hop 40.

client-b.purpose: ctl-b delivered by the existing client: secondary_photons=0.15 applied before hop 40.

client-reject.purpose: reject delivered by the existing client: photons=not-a-number before hop 30 is rejected by the production parser, the client sees the rejection and neither output changes.

client-comp-save.purpose: comp-save delivered by the existing client: the studio_ab composition before hop 0, then save_show before hop 64, into run-owned emulator flash.

client-comp-recover.purpose: Fresh process from client-comp-save's LittleFS: recovery issues no command (scheduled or client), reapplication or save.

cfg-save.purpose: Primary-only commands at hop 0. Since 7a7507b2 the product's delayed CONFIG save waits for the silence classifier (SILENCE_DWELL_MS 5000 after the smoke music ends at hop 128) as well as the 5 s debounce, so the save is due near app 7 s. The declared 1200-hop zero tail (app end 10.96 s) admits it with margin. Exactly one save is still required. No show-state file is written.

cfg-recover.purpose: Missing show-state fallback: boot from a flash with a saved CONFIG and no SHOW_STATE_V1.BIN.

music-a.purpose: Real-music passage through the default composition (A BLOOM 3, B WAVEFORM_TEMPO 18) with normal startup. Warm-up comes from the estimator: the tempo novelty window is 512 samples at 50 Hz = 10.24 s (k1_tempo.cpp:45) and lock needs confidence >= 0.60 plus two observed beats (k1_tempo.cpp:282), so hops 0-1599 (12.0 s) are uncaptured preroll and hops 1600-2933 (10.0 s) are scored.

startup-sqr.purpose: Normal startup on the boot-monotonic epoch, then active music, a declared zero section and the return; every second hop captured.
